The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants with a prayer to quash the order dated 21.12.2022 passed by Special Judge, POCSO Act, Ghaziabad rejecting the application of the applicant to recall the P.W.-2 for her cross-examination in S.T. No. 59 of 2022,
arising out of Case Crime No. 89 of 2022, under Sections 376 DB, 506 IPC and 5 MB/6 of POCSO Act, Police Station Murad Nagar, Ghaziabad and with further prayer to stay the further proceedings of the aforesaid case.
The facts in brief to the present case are that the First Information Report was lodged on 21.02.2022 by the opposite party no. 2 under Sections 376D, 506 IPC and 3/4 POCSO Act against the applicants with the allegation that her neice, aged about ten years, was lured by the accused persons and they Shan Ilahi And Another vs State Of U.P. sentences.text: The incident is of 21.02.2022 at about 6.00 P.M.
The applicants stand for trial in the said case.
The statement of victim was recorded as victim 'ABC' PW-2 before the Trial Court on 29.9.2022.
She was permitted to be cross-examined by the prosecution.
After her cross-examination on behalf of the accused persons her cross-examination by the prosecution was done.
Subsequently an application dated 07.12.2022 was filed with the prayer that the case be adjourned and some date be fixed for cross-examining the victim.
The said application stood rejected vide order dated 21.12.2022 which is the impugned order herein.

Learned counsel for the applicants argued that the victim 'ABC' was produced before the Trial Court as PW-2 and her testimony was recorded on 29.9.2022 in which after recording of her examination-in-chief she was cross- examined on behalf of the accused applicants.
Prosecution then sought permission from the Trial Court to cross- examine her which was granted and she was thus cross-examined.

From perusal of records, the counsel for the accused on 07.12.2022 after going through the records came to know that the case is fixed for further statement of the doctor and report of FSL but the cross-examination of the victim is still pending and as such they may be allowed to cross- examine her in the interest of justice.

It is argued that the Trial Curt has rejected the said application without properly adjudicating the facts and without considering that the said cross-examination was required to be done in the interest of justice.

It is argued that the present application be thus allowed and the victim 'ABC'
PW-2 to be recalled for her cross-examination.
Per contra learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer for summoning and cross-examination.
After having learned counsel for the parties and perusing the records, it is evident that the victim 'ABC' was produced as PW-2 before the Trial Court.
Her examination- in-chief was recorded after which she was cross-examined on behalf of accused persons.
The prosecution then requested for permission to cross-examine her which was allowed and then she was cross
-examined by the prosecution.
Subsequently, the application dated 07.12.2022 has been filed for the victim to be recalled for cross-examination from the side of the accused.

The Trial Court, vide order dated 21.12.2022, which is impugned herein, has rejected the said application on the ground that there is no provision under Section 154 of the Evidence Act to recall the witness for re-cross-examination.
Perused the said order also.
The order impugned dated 21.12.2022 is based on cogent and relevant facts and law.
There is no such stage for recall of the victim for re-cross-examination.
There is no irregularity or illegality in the order impugned.
The present application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. is thus devoid of merit and is hereby dismissed.
